reasons: GloFAS grids have not been matched to applicable river reaches and flood thresholds.
Urban inundation warning/risk feeds still need independent city-specific validation; rainfall and GloFAS point discharge alone do not establish inundation depth.
Weathernews pollen numeric arrays were retrieved, but the public pages are closed for spring-season preparation; operational applicability remains unverified.

Regional 3x3 sample grids provide actual 384h mean/spread guidance; official cyclone tracks and warnings must be combined with the grid at 06:00. The grid alone is not complete spatial cyclone coverage.
jma/kagawa_warnings: stale official issue timestamp; not current warning evidence

calculation_quality.note: Calculation success does not resolve missing original report requirements.

fog.basis: visibility with humidity, dew-point spread and low cloud at the same hours; official observations or advisories may corroborate further at report time

urban_inundation.basis: rainfall-rate screening of the IFS hourly precipitation; not an official warning; river flooding is assessed separately

model_crosscheck.note: NOAA GFS (gfs_seamless via Open-Meteo) as the independent second model; the report values remain the ECMWF IFS ones unless the official local observatory forecast contradicts them. The GFS frost limb is its 0–10 cm soil-layer temperature, NOT equivalent to the IFS surface (skin) temperature: contextual only, never a validation of the frost flag.

assessment.centre_identification_basis: single-point samples at the JTWC positions cannot locate a model centre
assessment.grid_resolution: 0.25 degrees (about 28 km): adequate for a coherence check against a named warning area, not for centre fixing

cyclone_watch.note: ABPW digest covers the advisory valid time; forecast tracks are in the jtwc/warning_* source texts. The ECMWF entry is the OpenCharts cyclone product probe (base-time walk-back; data or the API's own availability error, retained in the official bundle); GFS and ECMWF open-data track samples are the alternative routes when the product cannot be obtained. None of them silently replaces JTWC warnings.

scales.basis: issued alerts within 72 h before the newest alert (alerts.json spans about a month); geomagnetic also takes the outlook texts maximum
